rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Bounding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bounding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Bravery Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Caster
rules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

rules.name: Caster Group
rules.description: This model counts as having Caster(1).

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Defensive Growth
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule,  place one token on it at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four tokens. For every two tokens, this unit gets +1 to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Defensive Growth Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Defensive Growth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Delayed Action
rules.description: Once per round, if your opponent has more units left to activate than you, then this model's unit may pass its turn instead of activating (may still be activated later).

rules.name: Evasive
rules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where most models have this rule.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Furious
rules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Furious Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Hit & Run
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

rules.name: Indirect
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

rules.name: Infiltrate
rules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

rules.name: Inquisitorial Agent
rules.description: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being Fatigued when activated again). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round.

rules.name: Martial Prowess
rules.description: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being Fatigued when activated again). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round.

rules.name: Piercing Tag
rules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, place X tokens on one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight, or one token on X enemy units within 24" and in line of sight. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to block to get AP(+1) on their weapons.

rules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Precision Shooter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Protected
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Quick Throw
rules.description: This model may always target enemies that are not in line of sight when shooting with Indirect weapons (instead of only when using Hold actions).

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Relentless
rules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Shred
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Shred in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Spell Accumulator
rules.description: Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

rules.name: Spell Conduit
rules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

rules.name: Spell Drain
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed, it loses 2 spell tokens.

rules.name: Spell Resistance
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

rules.name: Spell Resistance Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Spell Resistance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Stealth Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Surge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Surprise Attack
rules.description: Counts as having Infiltrate. The first time this unit is activated, pick one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight, and roll X dice. For each 2+ it takes one hit with AP(1).

rules.name: Takedown
rules.description: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

rules.name: Takedown Shot
rules.description: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make X extra attacks against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

rules.name: Teleport
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
rules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

spells.name: Calculated Foresight
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Relentless against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Electric Tempest
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.

spells.name: Expel Threat
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Psy-Injected Courage
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get +1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Searing Burst
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 9 hits.

spells.name: Shock Speed
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).
